content.title: Reach support, status, and login entry points
content.description: An existing customer uses the public homepage as a routing surface to reach the Help Center, Support Plans, Partner Solutions, status pages, or the Console, Segment, and SendGrid login destinations, with verification ending at the public destination or login screen rather than attempting authentication.
content.summary: Use the homepage to reach support, status, and login destinations.
content.value: Lets current customers quickly exit the marketing site to the correct support or authentication surface.
criteria: The Support menu lists Help Center, Support Plans, and Partner Solutions.
The Login menu lists Console, Segment, and SendGrid, and coverage stops at presence and target validation rather than authenticating.
Resources navigation includes Help Center and Status pages as public destinations.
The Console login target must render its login screen over HTTPS, with no attempt to authenticate.
